response.text: Several findings so far. The duplicate invoice check found a pair, so I'll confirm it, check the AP-to-GL tie-out, and look at the invoice 465/801 journals.

arguments.sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", (SELECT SUM(l."CR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO") AS gl_cr FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (465,801)

SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", SUM(l."CR_AMT") AS ap_cr FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNL" l ON l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" AND TRIM(l."ACCT_CD") IN (SELECT TRIM("ACCT_CD") FROM "GLCOA" WHERE "ACCT_TYP"='LIABILITY') GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT" HAVING SUM(l."CR_AMT")<>i."INV_AMT"
SELECT p.* FROM "GLPERD" p WHERE p."PRD_ID"=2
